    def findMaximumElegance(self, items: List[List[int]], k: int) -> int:
        items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)

        min_right = []

        ans = float('inf')

        for i in range(n - 1):

                ml = nums[i]
            min_left.append(ml)
        
        # Build min_right: for each position i, store minimum value from i+1 to n-1

            min_right.append(mr)

            # Get minimum from left side (indices 0 to i-1) and right side (indices i+1 to n-1)

            # Check if current position forms a valid mountain triplet
            if left_min < nums[i] and nums[i] > right_min:

        groups = []

                # Can swap with previous, so add to current group
                current_group.append(i)
            else:
                # Cannot swap with previous, start new group
                groups.append(current_group)
                current_group = [i]
        
        # Add the last group
